name: Clopidogrel
executiveSummary: Antiplatelet (P2Y12 inhibitor, CYP2C19 prodrug). Adult: load **300–600 mg PO** then **75 mg/day**. With aspirin in ACS/stent (DAPT). Pediatrics: exceptional use (refractory Kawasaki, etc.) — specialist.
indications:
## Indications

- ACS (MI/unstable angina), post-stent, ischemic stroke/TIA, PAD — per guidelines ± aspirin.

## Precautions

- Bleeding — hold 5–7 days before major surgery if risk allows.
- Poor CYP2C19 metabolizers / omeprazole-esomeprazole: ↓ effect (prefer pantoprazole if PPI needed).
- Avoid chronic NSAIDs without protection; caution with anticoagulants.

> 600 mg load if urgent PCI (institutional protocol).

adulto.dose: Maintenance: **75 mg PO/day**. ACS/PCI load: **300 mg** or **600 mg** once, then 75 mg/day. DAPT duration: by stent/event (typically 1–12 months).
adulto.notes: Do not miss doses in critical post-stent window.

pediatrico.dose: Off-label: guide **1 mg/kg/day** (max 75) after load per protocol — pediatric cardiology/hematology only.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Bleeding, hematoma, dyspepsia; rare: TTP, neutropenia.
